name: Hold Doctrine
summary: Doctrine Benefit Hearthguard While wearing medium or heavy Kin armour, reduce non-critical weapon damage by 1. Ironhead You gain advantage on checks to mine, breach, salvage, demolish, or repair machinery and structures. Guild-Militant When you hit a creature marked by Oath-Mark, one ally within 30 ft gains +1 to hit that creature before your next turn.
